risk_description: Leak of diesel under pressure to the internal connection of the HP pump, owing to incomplete and incorrect application of the operating procedure when the engine is running. The fuel leakage in the engine compartment could increase the risk of fire.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
